suppressed.title: MissingPostStepConfiguration / unpausable new minter (pauser == address(0))
suppressed.reason: Suppressed as (1) admin-trust / centralization class and (2) root-cause predates the entry point. The new BatchNFTMinter is deployed with pauser == address(0), leaving it without a working emergency stop — but this is a PRE-EXISTING condition: the OLD minter being replaced was also unpausable, so the migration does not introduce or worsen the issue. It is an admin-trust/centralization observation whose root cause is the minter deployment pattern, not the batch-minter-migrate entry point under audit. Per CLAUDE.md known-invalid/out-of-scope classes (admin-trust / centralization; root cause OOS of the entry point), it is recorded as a suppressed note rather than an open finding.
